Class GameRenderer

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.view.GameRenderer
public class GameRenderer extends Object
Responsible for composing and printing the full terminal game screen. GameRenderer owns all layout constants and rendering helpers for the board, noble tiles, player track boxes, gem bank, menu panel, and move-history log. It deliberately contains no input logic; ConsoleView handles that separately. Layout overview (two-column terminal layout): LEFT COLUMN RIGHT COLUMN ───────────────────── ───────────────────────── Card tiers (3 → 1) Noble tiles (horizontal) Menu box | Bank box Recent move history Player track boxes (2 × 2) All rendering is ANSI-colour aware; card boxes are dimmed for unaffordable cards, and the active player's box is highlighted in gold.

    • clearDisplay

    • displayGameState

    • getRenderedGameState

      public String getRenderedGameState(Game game)
      Returns the full game screen as a single multi-line string without printing it. Used by network views that need to send the screen to a remote client.
      Parameters:
      game - The current game whose state should be rendered.
      Returns:
      The fully rendered terminal frame as a string.

    • renderToString

      public String renderToString(Game game)
      Alias for getRenderedGameState; exists so network code can call a semantically distinct name to clarify that the result is being sent over the wire.
      Parameters:
      game - The current game.
      Returns:
      The rendered game screen string.

    • displayPlayerTokens

      public void displayPlayerTokens(Player player)
      Prints each of the player's tokens that has a non-zero count to stdout, coloured in its gem colour. Used when prompting for token discards.
      Parameters:
      player - The player whose token inventory is displayed.

    • setMenuLines

      public void setMenuLines(List<String> menuLines)
      Replaces the current menu line list used in the next render call. Called by ConsoleView after building menu options but before re-rendering the screen.
      Parameters:
      menuLines - Pre-formatted menu strings, or null to clear the menu.

    • buildMenuLines

      public List<String> buildMenuLines(List<MenuOption> options, int winningPoints)
      Converts a list of MenuOption objects into a list of display strings for the menu panel. Unavailable options are rendered in dim colour with their reason.
      Parameters:
      options - The menu options built by MenuBuilder for the current turn.
      winningPoints - Current game winning-point threshold from configuration.
      Returns:
      List of formatted strings ready to be passed to setMenuLines().
